from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.cell.cell import MergedCell
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/55060/1_55060_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/55060_0_f0683986/1_55060_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Deal 8"]

# Put the correct Excel formula in J23 so it mirrors I12, but remains blank if I12 is blank.
ws["J23"] = '=IF(I12="","",I12)'

# Clear the rest of the allowed answer range if they are regular cells.
# If J23:N23 is merged, these will be MergedCell objects and cannot/need not be assigned.
for coord in ["K23", "L23", "M23", "N23"]:
    if not isinstance(ws[coord], MergedCell):
        ws[coord] = None

# Encourage recalculation when opened by Excel/compatible graders.
wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
